description: This schema captures the Q-value and separation-energy data typically found at the top of an Adopted Levels dataset.

source.description: The absence of this field means this Q-value is derived from measurements, either in the AME or some other source as indicated by the nsrKeys field.  If the AME derived the Q-value from systematics, then the corresponding 'systematics' flag should be set.  If the Q-value is not taken from data or the AME but from some theoretical calculation instead, 'theory' should be marked.
